verdict.rationale: Docs show create-domain, DNS record creation, WHOIS privacy, and TLD pricing/check-availability endpoints, and SDKs/sandbox for scripting, but there is no documented endpoint or example for setting registrant/admin/tech contacts or explicitly setting custom nameservers as part of the registration call itself. missing for 10: dedicated contacts-management endpoint, explicit set-nameservers API call, and an end-to-end worked example combining purchase+contacts+nameservers in one documented flow.
